title: Nano Bonding
flavorText: Filament paste that welds micro-plates into the skin of the hull.

title: Magnetic Shields
flavorText: Flux curtains that tug incoming energy bolts off their trajectories.
rulesText: −1 to all rolls by energy weapon attacks against this ship.

title: Energy Shields
flavorText: Capacitor lattice that catches and grounds overload from beam fire.
rulesText: Each energy weapon that hits this ship scores at most 1 hit.

title: Thermal Sinks
flavorText: Ablative panels you burn away to swallow a beamer's focus.
rulesText: Before attack dice are rolled, spend 1 H3 from the pool: remove up to 2 dice from this attack (you may reduce a weapon to 0 dice).

title: Inertial Dampener
flavorText: Gravity compensators that bleed momentum out of incoming slugs.
rulesText: −1 to all rolls by mass accelerator attacks against this ship.

title: Reactive Plating
flavorText: Explosive tiles that vent before kinetic rounds punch through.
rulesText: Reduce all mass accelerator attack dice by 1 against this ship.

title: Pulse Defense Grid
flavorText: Point-defense nets timed to spoil missile and drone solutions.
rulesText: −1 to all rolls by missile and drone attacks against this ship.

title: Decoy Launcher
flavorText: Spooled flares that rewrite what the seeker thinks is the ship.
rulesText: After the attacker rolls, before damage: spend 1 TC from the pool to negate a missile or drone attack against this ship.

title: Diamond Hull
flavorText: Full refit in fractal carbon laminate—space you will not get back.

title: Hull Plating
flavorText: Bolt-on plating packs that soak up the next lucky hit.

title: Magnetic Repulsor Grid
flavorText: Repulsor nodes that catch a salvo mid-flight and throw it back.
rulesText: When attacked by a mass accelerator weapon, choose any 2 attack dice after the roll; the attacker rerolls them. Once per attacking weapon.
